content.text: {"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo states that individual account debtors are 'permitted to pay directly to borrowers' under Operational Flexibility, but also claims under Collection Control that 'All Account Debtor payments must flow through Lockbox Accounts post-activation (except individual debtors)' - these cannot both be true simultaneously.", "The reconciliation standard states '>20% unreconciled collections during 15-day period within 10 business days triggers lender right to suspend advances' but this creates a logical impossibility where collections must be reconciled within 10 business days of a 15-day measurement period."]}
